picks.file: Charleroi - vue vers le pont de Sambre - vers 1900.jpg
picks.what: Houses along the Sambre toward the Sambre bridge, postcard photograph
picks.why: city scene on the old Sambre, very high resolution; trim cuts the caption and a handwritten number in the sky

picks.file: Charleroi - photo aérienne de la ville basse et la Sambre - 1919.jpg
picks.what: Aerial photograph of the lower town and the Sambre
picks.why: true general view of the lower town with the river; exact date

picks.what: Slag heap and steelworks seen from the Dampremy slag heap, photograph
picks.why: characteristic industrial landscape of Charleroi; no good modern view of the center among the candidates

gaps: P0, P1, P3: nothing; P2: only a castle in Monceau-sur-Sambre
notes: #1 (1690) shows the château of Monceau-sur-Sambre, then outside the town; #3 (Luce, 1895) shows the village of Couillet. #2 is dated only ‘début du 20e siècle’ on Commons; the handwriting on the front suggests an early, undivided-back card, so ‘about 1900’. Publisher Édition Surin is printed on the card. #4 (glassworks panorama, postmarked 1910) is an alternative for P4; #6 (about 1930, view from the Maison des Corporations) is an alternative for P5. #10 and #11 are aerials of wooded outer districts.
